1934, September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Blank Page
Sep. 24 Mrs. G. I. McVitty - 53 - widdow - nurse out of work.
Mrs. M. Cameron - 64 - bowel trouble.
Mrs. Grace Cunningham - 51 - operation for apendicitis & gall stones - attempted & abandoned - gall found broken .... Enrolled at 10:30 P.M. (50¢)
Mrs. Coon - 65 - threatening cancer Mrs. Helen Weeks - 36 of Toledo - stroke 4 months, quite lame .... Sister Monica - 55 - dizzy anxious.
Page 235 Page 236
·Blank Page
Sep. 17 Eva Larmer - 44 - of Alpina paralized all down right side - now 15 months - Enrolled To-day as perpetual member.
Eva Smalka - 23 - one little girl 4 & a baby 4 weeks - blood poison & heart "absolutely hopeless" doctors say - Enrolled To-day at 11:30 -45 perpetually. 28th leg very bad - only hope in prayer- enrolled again To-day for 2 yrs.
27 Harold F. Treppa - 30 - malaria T.B. .. Enrolled yesterday annual - promises more frequent Com. & perpet'l enrollment if improvement seen. Oct. 1 Improvement Reported - Enrolled perpet. $5.00 Mrs. Smith from Richmond - now Marine City - R.#3 - now kidney tr. Sarah Forton - 64 - diabetis, leg gone Mrs. Mary Hobile - 43 - had operation .. Blank Page
Page 237 Page 238 Sep. 29 Mrs. Louise Farrell of Owosso, Mich. - 58 - gall-trouble and almost in coma with diabetis when enrolled in Ser. Mass A. a year ago ..... at Monastery To-day to say that at time of enrollment improvement started at once .... now quite O.K.
Page 233 Page 234
